author: Good Enough
description:
He discovered gold in the Yukon, and it changed his life forever.

George Carmack was one of the men credited with finding gold during the Klondike Gold Rush, triggering a massive rush of prospectors into the region. But even after striking gold, he continued searching for more, driven by the hope of finding an even greater fortune.

This Short tells the story of the man who found gold… and couldn’t stop chasing it.

#goldrush
title: He Found Gold... and It Wasn't Enough 🥇😰 #didyouknow #history #americanhistory #darkhistory #facts

author: Good Enough
description:
Gold was discovered on his land, and it cost him everything.

When gold was found at Sutter’s Mill, it sparked the California Gold Rush, bringing thousands of people flooding onto his property almost overnight. Instead of becoming rich, John Sutter lost control of his land, his business collapsed, and he was left with nothing.

This Short tells the story of the man who should have made a fortune… but lost it all.
title: Gold Was Found... He Lost Everything 🥇😨 #didyouknow #history #goldrush #americanhistory
